label: GPT-6 Luna
output:
I’ve downloaded the logger. It went above 8°C at 22:50 on Saturday and came back below 8°C at 05:00 Sunday — about 6 hours 10 minutes out of range. The peak was 11.6°C at 02:15. Friday night’s minimum was 4.1°C, which was normal.

I found the alarm beeping at 07:55 this morning. The door wasn’t fully clicked shut. A box of Hartmann’s bags from Saturday’s delivery was stacked against it, and the seal is cracked at the bottom left; I had to lean on the door to get it to click. It looks like the box and the worn seal may both have contributed. Saturday clinic finished late after the RTA collie, and the delivery was put away in a rush at closing. The old ThermaTrak logger only sounds a local alarm — it doesn’t send text alerts, so nobody would have heard it overnight.

At 08:40 I rang Munster Vet Supplies’ tech line and spoke to Niamh, the pharmacist. Her advice was to quarantine everything and not use it. She asked us to email the logger CSV and batch numbers so they can check with the manufacturers and come back to us by Wednesday. She checked the manufacturer’s storage sheet against the readings for the insulin product we stock and cleared those four vials for use.

The stock in the fridge was 14 DHPPi, 9 lepto L4, 6 intranasal kennel cough, 3 rabies, 4 insulin vials and 2 cat flu/FeLV combos — about €1,150 at cost. The vaccines are quarantined in a sealed bag labelled DO NOT USE in the lab fridge. I checked that fridge at 5.2°C and started a new temperature sheet. I wouldn’t use or dispose of any of the quarantined vaccines until we hear back from the supplier.

Aoife, please keep the boosters on hold for now. If the supplier clears the vaccines, you can rebook them for Thursday or Friday. Otherwise, we could ask Carrigaline to lend us stock. Bonnie’s appointment has already been moved to Wednesday.

To help prevent a repeat, I suggest adding a fridge-door lock-up check to the closing checklist, including making sure nothing is obstructing it. The door seal needs replacing, and we should consider a logger with SMS alerts. The supplier catalogue lists one at about €180. Ciarán, can you OK the new seal and the SMS logger? I’ll email Niamh the CSV and batch numbers so they have them ahead of your call at 2.
